title: Arrow Attachments
description: Fuse items onto arrows, just like in Zelda.
body:
# Arrow Attachments

**Fuse anything. Shoot everything.**

![Banner](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2d4ea8b4ce98c7d883a3b92d9cd6d5a5535c5d03.png)

Arrow Attachments brings a *Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom*–inspired fusion system to Minecraft's ranged combat. Draw your bow, pick an item from a sleek in-game picker, and fuse it directly into your arrow — turning every shot into a tactical decision, a movement tool, or beautiful chaos.

---

## How It Works

While **aiming with a bow** or **holding a loaded crossbow**, a compact attachment picker appears above your hotbar. It shows **only compatible items** from your inventory — no clutter, no scrolling past junk.

1. Aim your bow (or hold a loaded crossbow)
2. Pick an attachment with the **mouse wheel** or **arrow keys**
3. Release — your item is fused into the projectile

A dedicated slot next to your hotbar always shows your **last selected attachment**, and the mod **remembers your previous choice**, so re-firing the same fusion takes zero extra clicks.

---

## Attachment Effects

Every supported item has its own handcrafted effect. A few highlights:

| Attachment | Effect |
|---|---|
| **Diamond** | High-damage precision shot |
| **Slime Ball** | Arrow bounces once off blocks |
| **Ender Pearl** | Teleports *you* to the impact point |
| **TNT** | A **real block-breaking explosion** on impact — no placed block, just boom |
| **Firework Rocket** | Launches as an actual rocket — and can **lift mobs into the air** |

…plus many more attachments adding **elemental damage, movement effects, crowd control, magic impacts, utility shots, and chaotic surprises**.

---

## Built to Feel Vanilla+

- Compact, **smoothly animated** UI with a magical "fusion" glow
- Readable and close to **Minecraft's vanilla style** — no bloated HUD
- **Full crossbow support**, including loaded-crossbow selection
- **Multishot-friendly**: only **one** attachment is consumed per shot — no wasted items

---

## Feature Overview

- Zelda-inspired projectile fusion system
- Works with **bows and crossbows**
- Smooth animated attachment picker (mouse wheel + arrow keys)
- Picker shows **only implemented, compatible items**
- Last-used attachment slot next to the hotbar
- Automatic memory of your previous selection
- TNT arrows create real block-breaking explosions
- Firework arrows launch as rockets and can carry mobs upward
- Bouncing Slime Ball arrows
- Ender Pearl teleport arrows
- Many more unique per-item effects
- Multishot consumes only one attachment per volley
- Clean, polished, fusion-styled UI

---

## Why You'll Love It

Ranged combat stops being *"shoot arrow, repeat."* Suddenly your inventory **is** your arsenal: every item becomes a new combat option, escape plan, mining trick, or gloriously unpredictable experiment.

> Grab a bow. Open your inventory. Start fusing.

---
